name: User not role
description: Provides a condition plugin that matches when a user does NOT have one or more of the selected roles.
project_description: Provides a "User Not Role" condition plugin that behaves as the opposite of Drupal core's "User Role" condition. A site builder adds it to a block's visibility settings (or any other condition consumer) to display a block only for users who do NOT have one or more selected roles. The condition computes the intersection of the configured role set and the current user's roles: when the intersection is empty the user lacks all of those roles and the condition passes (TRUE); when the intersection is non-empty the condition fails (FALSE). The standard negate checkbox inverts the result. Selecting no roles evaluates to TRUE for all users. The condition narrows its cache context to user.roles so results are correctly varied per role set. Configuration is stored as a condition.plugin schema (a sequence of role IDs).
